## Source
.design/m5/43-federation.md — REQ-8, AC-3, AC-6, AC-8 + decomposition PR 5.

## Surface
- New file: `polaris-backend/src/bin/polaris_federation_status.rs` — `polaris federation-status` admin command listing active escalations, states, last-message timestamps, signature-failure counts per peer.
- Extend `/metrics` (already shipped from operationally-complete REQ-D2) with new federation counters:
  - `polaris_federation_escalations_total{state, direction}` — counter
  - `polaris_federation_messages_total{direction, verify_status}` — counter
  - `polaris_federation_signature_failures_total{source_did}` — counter
  - `polaris_federation_peer_lag_seconds{peer_did}` — gauge (firehose seq lag)
- Extend WARN-alerting: signature-failure rate per peer above a configurable threshold emits a `tracing::warn!` with a structured event so operators' log aggregators can alert.

## Rust-quality notes
- Counter naming: follow the existing `polaris_*` prefix from operationally-complete REQ-D2. Don't invent a new prefix.
- Per rust-quality §3 (binary crate): admin binary returns `anyhow::Result<()>` with `.context("…")` at every IO boundary.
- The admin binary connects to the same Postgres URL as the running backend (read from env / config). It reads `federation_escalations`, `federation_messages`, `federation_state_transitions` directly — no HTTP round-trip to the backend.
- Output format: text table by default, `--format json` for scripting. Use the `tabled` crate (or similar workspace pattern) for the table; `serde_json` for JSON.
- The signature-failure WARN includes structured fields per rust-quality §10: `tracing::warn!(source_did = %did, recent_failures = %count, threshold = %limit, "federation signature failure rate exceeded threshold")`.
- Per `clippy::print_stdout` — admin binaries are CLIs so this is allowed at the crate root for this binary only. Library code never prints to stdout.

## External references
- `metrics` crate counter macros: https://docs.rs/metrics/latest/metrics/
- `tabled` crate: https://docs.rs/tabled/latest/tabled/
- Existing `/metrics` impl in-repo: `polaris-backend/src/api/metrics.rs`

## Acceptance (AC-8)
- [ ] `polaris federation-status` outputs at minimum: peer DID, escalation ID, state, opened timestamp, last-message timestamp, message count.
- [ ] `curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics | grep polaris_federation_` returns at least the four named series.
- [ ] Integration test forces a signature-failure WARN by tampering a record's signature; verify the tracing event is emitted with the expected structured fields.
